text.en:
The title of Republic Act Numbered Three thousand nine hundred forty-nine is amended to read as follows:
"An Act establishing a school for Philippine craftsmen in the Municipality of Merida, Province of Leyte, to be known as the Merida School of Home Industries, and authorizing the appropriation of funds therefor."

Section one of the same Act is amended to read as follows:
"

There is hereby established in the Municipality of Merida, Province of Leyte, a school to be known as Merida School of Home Industries for the promotion of home and small industries under the supervision and administration of the Home Industries Division, Bureau of Vocational Education."

Section three of the same Act is hereby amended to read as follows:
"

The sum of two hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of said school during the fiscal year nineteen hundred and seventy. Thereafter, the sums necessary for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, June 21, 1969.
